title: Run Metadata
description: Provenance and reproducibility metadata for every LLM call and audit run. Planned for implementation in PR2.

run_id.description: UUID for this specific run instance.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when the run started.

phase.description: Which pipeline phase this run belongs to.

provider.description: 'none' for deterministic (non-LLM) phases. 'ollama_fallback' outputs must not be aggregated with 'anthropic' outputs.

temperature.description: LLM temperature used. Must be 0.0 for all critic/reviewer calls. Null for non-LLM phases.

prompt_file.description: Relative path to the prompt file used, e.g. 'prompts/skeptical_analyst_v1.txt'. Null for non-LLM phases.

prompt_version.description: Version tag from the prompt file name, e.g. 'v1'. Null for non-LLM phases.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the prompt file contents at time of run. Enables detection of accidental prompt changes.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the actual input sent to the model (report text, claim summary, etc.).

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw model response before any parsing.

fallback_used.description: True if Ollama was used as fallback because Anthropic was unavailable. Affects result comparability.

source_tier.description: For fact_verification phase: tier of the data source used. Null for LLM phases.

claims_extracted.description: Number of claims extracted (claim_extraction phase only).
